overdose_case.description: Patient prescribed excessive dose of paracetamol
overdose_case.text:
Patient: John Doe, Age: 45
Prescription:
- Paracetamol 5000 mg twice daily for 7 days
- Ibuprofen 400 mg three times daily
Symptoms: Headache, fever
Lab values: Glucose 95 mg/dL, Creatinine 1.0 mg/dL

interaction_case.description: Dangerous drug interaction between warfarin and aspirin
interaction_case.text:
Patient: Jane Smith, Age: 68
Prescription:
- Warfarin 5 mg once daily
- Aspirin 100 mg once daily
- Metformin 500 mg twice daily
Condition: Atrial fibrillation, Type 2 diabetes
Lab values: INR 2.5, HbA1c 7.2%

redflag_case.description: Patient with red flag symptoms requiring immediate attention
redflag_case.text:
Patient: Robert Johnson, Age: 55
Chief Complaint: Severe chest pain radiating to left arm
Symptoms: Chest pain, shortness of breath, nausea, sweating
Vitals: BP 150/95, Heart rate 95 bpm
Prescription:
- Aspirin 300 mg once daily
- Atorvastatin 20 mg once daily

missing_tests_case.description: Patient on statin without liver function tests
missing_tests_case.text:
Patient: Mary Williams, Age: 62
Prescription:
- Atorvastatin 40 mg once daily
- Lisinopril 10 mg once daily
Condition: Hyperlipidemia, Hypertension
Lab values: Cholesterol 220 mg/dL, LDL 150 mg/dL
Note: No liver function tests performed

guideline_violation_case.text:
Patient: David Brown, Age: 50
Condition: Type 2 Diabetes, HbA1c 8.5%
Prescription:
- Ibuprofen 400 mg three times daily
- Omeprazole 20 mg once daily
Note: No metformin prescribed despite diabetes diagnosis
Lab values: Glucose 180 mg/dL, HbA1c 8.5%
